name: SimWorld
description: A research project exploring how physical processes, life, learning and institutions might connect through one reproducible simulated history.
statusDescription: The current build is a reduced stochastic physics model. The wider world remains a research program.

paper.title: SimWorld Research White Paper
paper.snapshotNote: Version 1.1 covers all 17 detailed phase plans, the current dependency ledger, and verified Windows/Linux CI at source commit 4134abd. Planned capabilities remain distinct from the reduced implemented baseline.
paper.historicalEvidenceNote: The original 29 October 2026 simulation audit is preserved; this publication revision does not claim a new physical experiment.

principles.title: Computed consequences
principles.text: Properties should follow from explicit models and interactions, with fitted assumptions and missing mechanisms disclosed.

principles.title: A traceable history
principles.text: Seeded events, recorded causes and state hashes make each experiment inspectable and repeatable.

principles.title: Evidence before scale
principles.text: The roadmap expands through tested interfaces, independent benchmarks and measured approximation errors.

implemented.title: Cooling micro-seed
implemented.text: Eight-cell thermal populations with prescribed expansion, effective nucleon formation, nuclear reactions and electron capture.

implemented.title: Deterministic replay
implemented.text: A fresh seed-42 run reproduced the archived result and all 34 hashes in the audited environment.

implemented.title: Inspectable experiments
implemented.text: The Python implementation, 65-test suite, prototype reports and full-precision audit evidence are downloadable.

findings.title: Repeatable does not mean physically validated
findings.text: The green suite verifies existing regression criteria. Broad fitted bands do not establish precision cosmology.

findings.title: Reverse kinetics need further work
findings.text: Diagnostics found missing nuclear reverse-path reachability and an absorbing fully neutral atomic state.

findings.title: Random-stream identity needs refinement
findings.text: Repeated calls at the same stream coordinates reuse prefixes, even when their payloads differ.

findings.title: Prototype speed is not engine speed
findings.text: The array microbenchmark and the dictionary-backed main engine use different storage. Their throughput cannot be equated.

researchQuestions: Can reversible kernels reach the same equilibrium from both directions?
What information must survive compression for later predictions to remain reliable?
Can independent physical mechanisms be coupled without losing conservation or provenance?
Which higher-level patterns survive changes in seeds, parameters and environments?

references.title: Precision big bang nucleosynthesis with improved Helium-4 predictions
references.authors: Cyril Pitrou; Alain Coc; Jean-Philippe Uzan; Elisabeth Vangioni
references.topic: Place SimWorld's broad H/He bands in context; explain why acceptance tests are not a precision cosmology validation.

references.title: One percent determination of the primordial deuterium abundance
references.authors: Ryan Cooke; Max Pettini; Charles C. Steidel
references.topic: An explicit external reference benchmark for deuterium, which cannot be scientifically validated by accepting an exact zero in a small-particle realization.

references.title: Ultrafast effective multi-level atom method for primordial hydrogen recombination
references.topic: A concrete example of scientifically justified precomputation and coarse-graining compatible with derived physics. A hydrogenic binding scale alone does not establish an accurate recombination history.

references.title: Decoherence, einselection, and the quantum origins of the classical
references.topic: Distinguish physical decoherence from observer-driven rendering and from SimWorld's threshold-based materialization rule.

references.title: Models of wave-function collapse, underlying theories, and experimental tests
references.authors: Angelo Bassi; Kinjalk Lochan; Seema Satin; Tejinder P. Singh; Hendrik Ulbricht
references.topic: Explain why a software collapse event should be described as an effective modeling operation unless tied to an explicit, falsifiable physical model.

references.title: Heterogeneous multiscale method: A general methodology for multiscale modeling
references.authors: Weinan E; Bjorn Engquist; Zhongyi Huang
references.topic: Frame the roadmap as a hierarchy of closure models with tested interfaces, not a promise that every microscopic degree of freedom can be explicitly simulated across all epochs.

references.title: The ODD Protocol for Describing Agent-Based and Other Simulation Models: A Second Update to Improve Clarity, Replication, and Structural Realism
references.venue: Journal of Artificial Societies and Social Simulation 23(2), 7
references.topic: Recommend per-phase and nested ODD descriptions, explicit evaluation patterns, initialization, stochasticity, scheduling, and submodel documentation for reproducible later-stage agents.

references.title: Exact stochastic simulation of coupled chemical reactions
references.topic: A reference method for validating stochastic reaction stepping and for separating sampling error from rate-model error.

references.title: Required Levels of Catalysis for Emergence of Autocatalytic Sets in Models of Chemical Reaction Systems
references.authors: Wim Hordijk; Stuart A. Kauffman; Mike Steel
references.topic: Define intermediate Phase 8 tests: catalytic closure and persistence are distinct from heredity, selection, compartmentalization, and open-ended evolution.

references.title: The evolutionary origin of complex features
references.authors: Richard E. Lenski; Charles Ofria; Robert T. Pennock; Christoph Adami
references.topic: Show that emergent complexity can be studied by controlled computational experiments with explicit rules and recorded evolutionary trajectories.

reproduce.scope: Exact reproduction is established for the audited machine and source environment; cross-platform equivalence requires separate testing.
